import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exps = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']+exps).copy()

# cool_rate robustness: per-lab slope
for lab in sorted(d['lab'].unique()):
    sub=d[d['lab']==lab]
    X=sm.add_constant(sub[['cool_rate']])
    m=sm.OLS(sub['tensile_mpa'],X).fit()
    print(f"{lab}: n={len(sub)} coef={m.params['cool_rate']:.3f} p={m.pvalues['cool_rate']:.3f}")

# quadratic
d['cr2']=d['cool_rate']**2
X=pd.get_dummies(d[['cool_rate','cr2','lab']],columns=['lab'],drop_first=True).astype(float)
X=sm.add_constant(X)
m=sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'],X).fit()
print("quad cool_rate p:", m.pvalues['cool_rate'], "cr2 p:", m.pvalues['cr2'])

# press_time raw vs lab
print("\npress_time raw corr:", d['press_time'].corr(d['tensile_mpa']))
print(d.groupby('lab')[['press_time','tensile_mpa']].mean())
